critical_code_review_comments: Minor: YearEndClosingModal uses window.confirm() (native browser dialog) for the final confirmation instead of a custom shadcn confirm modal - functional but inconsistent UX with the rest of the app
OK: _migrate_add_gyal_heads() is properly idempotent (checks existing_keys before inserting)
OK: year-end-closing preview and POST both use same query (is_gyal $ne True, loan_date $lte cutoff) - consistent behavior
OK: _book_emi_collection handles is_gyal loans separately (uses gyal_wasool head instead of loans_portfolio) - Gyal Wasool recovery works
OK: CollectionSheet frontend properly splits regularRows/gyalRows and renders separator only when gyalRows.length > 0
OK: loans.py is 581 lines - approaching 700 line limit but within acceptable range
